mapper.select: SELECT s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, MIN(se.price) AS minimum_price, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.latitude, s.longitude FROM Salons s LEFT JOIN Services se ON se.salon_id = s.salon_id GROUP BY s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, s.created_at, s.updated_at ORDER BY s.average_rating DESC, s.salon_id DESC

SELECT s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, MIN(se.price) AS minimum_price, s.created_at, s.updated_at, u.user_name, closed_at FROM Salons s LEFT JOIN Services se ON se.salon_id = s.salon_id join Users u on u.user_id = s.owner_id WHERE s.salon_id = #{salonId} GROUP BY s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.closed_at
SELECT service_id, salon_id, service_name, price, duration_minutes, description, created_at, updated_at FROM Services WHERE salon_id = #{salonId} ORDER BY price, service_id
SELECT hour_id, salon_id, day_of_week, open_time, close_time FROM Salon_Operating_Hours WHERE salon_id = #{salonId} AND day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} LIMIT 1
SELECT salon_id, owner_id, salon_name, address, phone_number, description, average_rating, image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM Salons WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY salon_id
